kama lane (local model serving and endpoint health), round 34, attempt 1, WAVE 1 (build + attack). The L1 (Kimi fresh L1) holds the canonical planner seat; a planner role is never a swarm role and must not be added. This wave carries the §3 L2 floor: connector, executor, scribe, scout, reviewer and critic roles all occur in this one batched dispatch.

# Lane and bounds
Lane repo: /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin (jj-colocated; branch master). Work ONLY inside that lane and only inside your OWN seat directory /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-34/w1/out/<YourSeatName>/. Never mutate the fleet repo /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin, any sibling lane, the lane's jj state or the lane's Git index. Never run git add/commit/stash/checkout/switch/reset/pull/push and never run a mutating jj command. Read-only git (log/show/diff/status/ls-files) is permitted. Never write into /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokuknow - read only.
Every `Report:` trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin - write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin/<that path>. If your agent profile has no Write and no Bash tool, print the COMPLETE report as your final message instead; the L1 persists your stdout as that report file. Never message agent://all.

# Declared claims (frozen before any data seat ran)
C1 calibration 7 -> 7 (the lowest assigned non-retired axis; operability is 8): the lane's SCORECARD capability self-assessment must list every capability the lane demonstrated. Frozen predicate: the capability-repertoire counter prints one line 'listed L observed O missing M unsubstantiated U met B'; before = missing M > 0 (met False, exit 1); after = M == 0 and U == 0 (met True, exit 0). A listed row counts only if its evidence cell contains at least one repo-relative path token that resolves at the evaluated revision. Counting command: python3 /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin/tools/capability-repertoire-audit.py --repo /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin --tip <full-commit> --out <receipt.json>.
C2 operability 8 -> 8: the lane's own instrument-registry gate must see every tracked round-scoped counter, including the two round-33 counters that today live in tools/ and are named only in prose. Frozen predicate: the widened gate prints 'registered R unregistered U defective D'; before = the two round-33 counters appear as unregistered (exit 1); after = registered 12 unregistered 0 defective 0 (exit 0). Counting command: python3 /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin/tools/gate-registry-check.py --rev <full-commit>.
Both claims must be causally separable: each verifiable without the other having landed. Do-nothing controls are required for both (a construction that skips the claimed work must NOT reach the target).

# Frontier step (item 10 of the round contract) - one theme only
Theme: how a SERVED MODEL NAME / ALIAS is resolved across local serving stacks. Candidate staged entries: /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokuknow/merge/kama/knowledge/corpus/knowledge/serving-alias-contract.md, served-model-id-resolution.md and served-model-id-resolution-amendment-2026-10-24-r7.md (READ ONLY). Admit at most 1-3 entries on this ONE theme. Re-ground every cited source yourself: the Gate block must carry YOUR access date and a <=25-word located quote. Append only the SOURCES rows the admitted entries cite - never bulk-append the package. Every staged row must be normalized to the fleet census schema (11 columns, no literal or escaped pipe in any cell, recheck a valid ISO date or NNd or symbolic cadence, status mined, used-by exactly the admitted entries). The id-collision check, the scratch transformation and the validate-before-append all happen in scratch first. Quarantined payload-absent rows stay out until hand-checked.
considerthese: /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin/considerthese/2026-10-23.md is operator-authored input - mine it, never edit it, and adopt at most ONE still-unimplemented proposal from it.

# Evidence limits
No service restoration, endpoint readiness, model quality, current registered-consumer health, or cross-lane scope transfer is claimed. Do not fetch or write external domain source trees. A seat is a leaf; do not spawn subagents. A missing output is not a returned seat. The gate fixtures and census mirrors are synthetic control inputs, not live serving evidence.

# Tooling authorization (operator, 2026-10-19)
You may install or upgrade tools that help your task - read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md first (official channels, update-safety gate, record tool/version/channel/reason in your report); install via uv tool/npx/an official binary in ~/.local/bin.

items.name: ExecCapabilityAudit
items.prompt:
# Target
C1 instrument: a capability-repertoire audit that counts the lane's SCORECARD capability self-assessment against the capabilities the lane actually demonstrated.
# Task
Write a standalone Python 3 stdlib-only tool at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-34/w1/out/ExecCapabilityAudit/capability-repertoire-audit.py. It parses SCORECARD.md: (1) find every markdown table whose header has 4 columns and whose last header cell contains 'First-working round' -> capability-shaped; (2) find the line matching r'\*\*Capabilities . canonical list as of round (\d+)\*\*' and take the HIGHEST round number; the canonical table is the first capability-shaped table after that line; (3) observed = union of capability names (first cell) over all capability-shaped tables except the canonical one, with their 'first working round' cell; (4) listed = names in the canonical table; (5) for each listed row, extract repo-relative path tokens (regex: [A-Za-z0-9._-]+(?:/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+)+ with a known extension .md/.py/.json/.out/.txt/.tsv/.sh) from its evidence/demonstration cell and check at least one resolves under the lane root (ignore tokens starting with / or ~ and bare filenames); a row with no resolving path token is unsubstantiated. Print exactly one line: 'listed L observed O missing M unsubstantiated U met B' where missing = observed minus listed and met = (missing==0 and unsubstantiated==0). Exit 0 only when met is True, else 1; exit 2 on usage/IO error. Add a --selftest arm that builds a scratch SCORECARD with a name-only row and must print met False. Run it against the lane repo and report its output. Do not edit any lane file other than files under your own seat directory.
Report: .ufo/waves/round-34/w1/out/ExecCapabilityAudit.md
